items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...who would be your favorite you played with several of those fellows like Chris Kelly and Renee Lee Collins... [INTERVIEWEE] ...well I think red kid Rene yeah kid Rene he was a sweet trumpet player

ctx.x: Bob Lyons how did he play Bob Lyons well he played pretty good he was a pretty good bass player in them time well you call them good bass players in them time

yeah that's a lot of good yeah good bass players like old man Glinny yes I might ask a little bit about the trumpet players again who would be your favorite you played with several of those fellows like Chris Kelly and Renee Lee Collins and you heard Buddy Petey you know who would be the Oliver who would be the best trumpet players of all that you heard in your whole life my whole life way back or later anytime at all between

Rene and Oliver I mean not you all between Rene and Buddy Petey or all of them punch any of them yeah all of them well the best one you ever worked with well I think red kid Rene yeah kid Rene he was a sweet trumpet player yeah and he wasn't gonna make he wasn't gonna make nothing unless he was sure he was gonna make it that's what I used to like about him yeah yeah
